entities.name: Marvo
entities.description: Octopus rogue of Ravnica given augmented intelligence by a Simic experiment.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose experiment augmented Marvo's intelligence.

events.summary: A Simic experiment massively augments the intelligence of the octopus Marvo; he escapes into the undercity waterways.
events.quote: he escaped into the undercity's waterways

events.summary: Marvo leaves the evidence of a Simic biotheft case wrapped in kelp for the Agency detectives, who credit an unknown aquatic assistant.
events.quote: the evidence they needed was on the banks, neatly wrapped in strips of kelp like a present
